proposalTemplates.title: Governed emergency leak response automation
proposalTemplates.impact: Detect a leak, prepare valve closure, notify the operator, and attach evidence before physical actuation.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: Manual valve override stays authoritative; automation can be disabled without changing device state.

proposalTemplates.title: Policy-gated valve command proposal
proposalTemplates.impact: Prepare a command object only; no valve command is executed by AIP.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: Command expires unless approved and simulated.

proposalTemplates.title: Semantic narrowband fallback route
proposalTemplates.impact: Route compact P0/P1 command intents over LoRaWAN or LTE-M while blocking bulk traffic.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: Fallback route remains simulated until explicit permission is attached.

proposalTemplates.title: Governed module enablement plan
proposalTemplates.impact: Create a build plan for services, dashboards, policies, tests, and IaC fragments without mutating Docker or Azure.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: Plan can be rejected or revised before any files or infrastructure are changed.

proposalTemplates.title: Module enablement approval placeholder
proposalTemplates.impact: Prepare the approval envelope for future enablement; execution remains disabled in E08.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: No enablement occurs until certification and approval records exist.

proposalTemplates.title: Lighting scene preview
proposalTemplates.impact: Prepare grouped lighting commands with zone, brightness, fade, and manual override evidence.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: No fixture state changes are made until the operator applies the simulated command plan.

proposalTemplates.title: Low-risk lighting scene apply
proposalTemplates.impact: Apply a low-risk scene through the lighting command boundary after review.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: Previous scene can be replayed from the audit record or replaced by manual control.

proposalTemplates.title: Climate comfort profile preview
proposalTemplates.impact: Prepare thermostat setpoints, holds, mode changes, and comfort evidence without adapter execution.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: Existing thermostat schedule remains unchanged until the operator applies the simulated command plan.

proposalTemplates.title: Safe climate setpoint apply
proposalTemplates.impact: Apply safe medium-risk thermostat setpoints through the climate command boundary after review.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: Previous schedule can be replayed from the audit record or replaced by manual thermostat control.

proposalTemplates.title: Battery reserve aware EV charging proposal
proposalTemplates.impact: Propose a tariff-aware charging window while protecting battery reserve, solar surplus, and critical-load boundaries.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: Existing charger schedule remains unchanged until approved.

proposalTemplates.title: High-risk access proposal
proposalTemplates.impact: Prepare an access-state check or command proposal without unlocking or opening anything.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: No physical access state changes occur through AIP.

proposalTemplates.title: Security profile preview
proposalTemplates.impact: Prepare lock, arm, and state-check commands while leaving unlock/open actions approval-gated.
proposalTemplates.rollbackPath: No access state changes occur until the operator applies the simulated secure profile.

seedSessions.summary: Leak response with simulation, approval, and narrowband fallback evidence.
MQTT and ESPHome module enablement plan.
Warm evening lighting scene with manual override and audit evidence.
Evening climate comfort profile with safe setpoint and audit evidence.
